## Professional Summary

Pasindu Sampath is a self-taught Software Engineer from Sri Lanka who began his programming journey in April 2021. With no formal computer science degree guiding his initial path, he learned programming fundamentals, data structures, object-oriented programming, enterprise frameworks, and databases entirely through self-study and determination. He secured his first professional Software Engineer position in August 2024, turning years of independent learning into real-world impact.

Beyond engineering, Pasindu is the founder of CodeSchool.lk, an online education platform where he teaches programming to university students across Sri Lanka. He is recognized for his exceptional teaching style — making even the most complex concepts simple, clear, and engaging.

He is also a content creator who makes comedy and tech-related content, known for his humor, sarcasm, and ability to make people smile.

---

## Journey & Timeline

### April 2021 — The Beginning
Started the self-study journey into programming. Learned programming fundamentals from scratch including data representation in computer memory, string manipulation, bitwise operations, control flow (if-else, loops), recursion, and arrays.

### 2021–2022 — Mastering the Core
Dove deep into computer science concepts: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Data Structures. These form the backbone of every great software engineer.

### 2022–2023 — Enterprise Frameworks
Learned to build robust, production-grade applications with industry-standard Java frameworks: Spring Boot and Hibernate.

### 2023–2024 — Data & Persistence
Mastered database design, querying, and data management. Focused on MySQL and building data-driven applications.

### August 2024 — First Professional Role
Officially began professional career as a Software Engineer — turning years of self-study into real-world impact.

### 2024–Present — Growing with Teams
Leveling up through real-world collaboration — debugging alongside colleagues, clarifying what customers truly need, and helping teammates succeed. Skills: Team Collaboration, Debugging, Customer Communication.

## Work Experience

### Softsora — Software Engineer → Associate Software Engineer
**Period:** August 2024 – Present (~2 years as of August 2026)  
**Type:** Full-time | **Location:** Sri Lanka  
**Current Role:** Associate Software Engineer (ASE)

Pasindu joined Softsora as a Junior Software Engineer in August 2024 — his first professional role. Over two years, he has grown into the Associate Software Engineer (ASE) position. During this time he has:

- Contributed to **6+ projects** as a collaborative team member across agile sprints
- Been **promoted** from Junior Software Engineer to Associate Software Engineer
- Serves as a **Code Reviewer** — manually reviewing implementations to ensure human-readable, maintainable code that adheres to company-wide coding standards
- Developed strong **client communication** skills — learning how to understand client needs, manage expectations, and translate real-world business problems into technical solutions
- Built expertise in **real-world debugging** — understanding how bugs emerge in production systems and developing systematic approaches to resolution
- Gained full exposure to the **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**: system design, implementation, testing, and agile delivery
- Plays a key role in **maintaining and raising the engineering quality bar** for the team

**Skills gained:** Agile Development, Code Review, Client Communication, Team Collaboration, System Implementation, Debugging, Coding Standards, SDLC

---

### Cyber Yakku — Backend Engineer
**Period:** Early experience (before August 2024)  
**Type:** Collaborative / Team | **Location:** Sri Lanka

Pasindu was involved with the Cyber Yakku team on software development projects serving local Sri Lankan clients. His primary contribution was **server-side development for a mobile application**, where he served as the Backend Engineer within the team. This experience provided practical exposure to client-focused software delivery in a collaborative team setting.

**Skills gained:** Backend Development, Server-Side Development, Mobile App APIs, Client-Focused Development

## CodeSchool.lk — Education Platform

Pasindu is the founder and lead instructor of CodeSchool.lk, an online programming education platform. He teaches:

- Java Fundamentals
- Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
- Data Structures
- Spring Boot
- Hibernate
- MySQL Databases
- JavaScript
- React
- JavaFX

### Teaching Philosophy
Pasindu's teaching approach is centered on simplicity. He breaks down even the most complex concepts into simple, clear explanations that are approachable for beginners while still providing valuable insights for experienced developers. He uses practical examples and maintains a friendly, engaging teaching style.

### Student Universities
His students come from top universities in Sri Lanka including:
- University of Colombo School of Computing (UCSC)
- University of Jaffna
- NSBM Green University
- University of Westminster (IIT Sri Lanka)
- Java Institute

## Content Creation

Beyond coding and teaching, Pasindu creates comedy and tech-related content. His content style includes:

- **Acting Dumb**: Comedy through pretending confusion — making everyday situations hilarious
- **Meme Lord**: Turning developer struggles into relatable memes
- **Sarcasm Expert**: Fluent in sarcasm as a second programming language
- **Making People Smile**: The core goal — if his content makes someone smile, mission accomplished

Self-described quote: "I write code that works (eventually), and content that makes people forget their code doesn't."

---

## This Portfolio

This portfolio website (pasindusampath.com) is itself a demonstration of Pasindu's engineering skills. It's not a static website — it's a full-stack web application built with:

- **Next.js 16** (App Router + React 19)
- **TypeScript** for type safety
- **Tailwind CSS 4** for styling
- **Framer Motion** for animations
- **Google Sheets API** as a free database ($0/month)
- **Cloudinary** for image hosting and optimization
- **JWT Authentication** for the admin panel
- **ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration)** for performance

Features include:
- Admin dashboard for content management
- Dynamic content (projects, profile, skills, daily notes)
- Interactive survival counter (calculates time alive)
- Visitor footprint constellation canvas
- Student testimonials section
- Responsive design for all devices

The portfolio costs $0/month to run, using free tiers of Google Sheets API, Cloudinary, and Vercel.
